'''Soun IV''' was an astronomical object<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> located in the [[Soun system/Legends|Soun system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Outer Expansion Zone/Legends|Outer Expansion Zone]] sub-region<ref name="Outer" /> and the [[Freestanding subsectors/Legends|freestanding subsectors]] portion of<ref name="Expansion" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="22 BBY">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'' depicts the [[Unidentified Soun IV princess/Legends|princess]] from Soun IV visiting the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] at the same [[Time/Legends|time]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] visiting the establishment during the events of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> a [[Unidentified Soun IV princess/Legends|princess]] from Soun IV visited the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CL" /> By [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the Soun [[Star system/Legends|system]] fell within the borders of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Soun IV was introduced in the [[2003]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'', authored by [[Simon Beecroft]].<ref name="Inside">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Soun system, and therefore Soun IV, in grid square J-8.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to ''The Essential Atlas'' further placed the Soun system in the [[Mondress sector/Legends|Mondress sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> however, this was contradicted by both the [https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region], a [[2012]] feature of the Online Companion,<ref name="Expansion" /> and the 2012 reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', both of which placed the system in the freestanding [[Sector/Legends|subsectors]] area of the Expansion Region, outside the Mondress sector.<ref name="EGTW" /> This article assumes the latter placement of the Soun system is correct.
